d: A Mario Kart DS PSVita Port.
ld: This is a native PS Vita port of Mario Kart DS, made from the Mario Kart DS decompilation. It's not an emulator: the game's own code (in game/) runs directly on the Vita, and the parts of the DS it relies on (graphics, sound, timers, save chip, wireless and so on) are rebuilt in platform/. The 3D is drawn by the Vita's GPU.
req:
- ur0:tai/CapUnlocker.skprx
- libshacccg.suprx in ur0:data/.
- Your own dump of Mario Kart DS (Europe, AMCP).
